# Peroxiredoxin
**Peroxiredoxins (Prx)** are a family of antioxidant enzymes that reduce [[Hydrogen Peroxide]], [[Peroxynitrite|peroxynitrite]], and organic hydroperoxides. They are regenerated by [[Thioredoxin]].

#

## Connections
- [[Thioredoxin]] — Reduces oxidized peroxiredoxin
- [[Glutathione]] — Parallel antioxidant system
- [[Oxidative Stress]] — Prx are critical for redox homeostasis
